description: Swimming, held out (physics.md 6.6; replaces swim_cove_dive, retired by the owner 2026-10-09): fall into the Colorado River at Cottonwood Cove from its surface (the WastelandNV default -2300), float, then dive north-east along a view pitched 30 degrees down with forward held (Always Run) over 600 units of water: the forward stroke cycle along the view (339 units/s, `stroke` forward). The capture loads the cell with `cow` first (a long SetPos alone left cells unloaded, physics.md 6.6).
